info.name: FAOSTAT Bulk Download Catalog Downloads API
Download a bulk dataset ZIP file

params.name: filename
params.description: ZIP filename as listed in the catalog (e.g. Production_Crops_Livestock_E_All_Data_NOFLAG.zip)

items.docs: Downloads a complete FAOSTAT dataset as a compressed ZIP file containing one or more CSV files. Filenames are obtained from the catalog endpoint. Files may be several hundred megabytes for large domains.
